name: Animated Hut
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A one-room wooden hut supported in the air with massive chicken legs. Its heavy steps boom against the ground as it lumbers forward.
tactics: Animated Huts keep allies inside, protecting them (see Close Shutters) when they’re injured and being fired at with magic or projectiles. They Stomp singular Attackers while knocking them Prone or Kick multiple Attackers at once.
lore: The first Animated Hut was created by a powerful witch to protect her against angry villagers blaming her for all their problems, and has since been a popular creation of reclusive witches and hags.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.details: While motionless and Prone, you’re indistinguishable from a mundane hut.

abilities.name: Animated Building
abilities.details: You are a building with a 4 Space wide, 4 Space long, 2 Space tall interior and a single 1 Space wide door that only creatures of your choice can pass through. Creatures inside you can see and Attack out of windows unimpeded while your walls provide them with 3/4 Cover.

abilities.name: Suspended Building
abilities.details: When standing, your entrance and interior is 2 Spaces above the ground. When you fall Prone or die, your entrance, interior, and everything inside you falls to the ground.

abilities.name: Stomp
abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 4 Bludgeoning.

Prone (+1 AP): +1 damage and target makes a Might Save. Failure: Target falls Prone.

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 4 Space Line, 3 Bludgeoning.

abilities.name: Close Shutters
abilities.details: When a creature inside you is Attacked, the Attack is made against you instead. You take all the damage and the effects instead of them, including making any accompanied Saves.

name: Bloated Zombie
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A bloated, rotting corpse reeking of rot and decay. It groans as it shambles toward living flesh.
tactics: Bloated Zombies mindlessly Strike and Grapple the nearest enemy, then Bite them. Once a target is down, they’ll go after the next nearest one.
lore: Bloated Zombies are zombies raised from the body of plague victims who had already been decomposing for several days. Magical plagues can lead to them forming in large swarms.

abilities.name: Unrelenting
abilities.details: The only way you can be reduced below 1 HP is by a Heavy Hit or an Attack that deals Radiant damage.

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 3 Bludgeoning and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Grappled. While Grappled, target is also Dazed.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.details: A Grappled target: Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 2 Piercing + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit and target makes a Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target is Impaired for 1 minute. This is a Basic Disease.

abilities.name: Death Burst
abilities.details: When reduced to 0 HP, you burst in an explosion of diseased gore. Area Martial Attack vs AD, 1 Space Aura, 1 Corrosion and target makes a Repeated Might Save. Success: Target is Impaired for 1 minute. This is a Basic Disease.

name: Dire Viper
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A massive green serpent with dark green stripes on hard scales. Ridges on its scaly face make it look like it’s permanently scowling, and its hissing breath gives it an especially fearsome presence.
tactics: Being ambush predators, Dire Vipers lie in wait until their prey is close enough to Bite, then they strike from the shadows. In Combat, they Bite from max range then slither away (see Evasive Slither), usually up trees to avoid retaliation.
lore: Dire Vipers live in areas of thick underbrush or canopies, where they can hide and ambush prey. They usually eat horses and other large animals. Caravans will frequently abandon horses struck by the viper when Attacked, coming back for any carriages after the snake has left.

abilities.name: Stealthy
abilities.details: You have ADV on Stealth Checks.

abilities.name: Ambush Predator
abilities.details: Your first Attack each combat deals +3 damage. If the target is Surprised, you have ADV on the Attack.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 3 Spaces, 4 Piercing and target makes a Might Save. Failure: Target takes 2 Poison damage at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute. This is a Basic Poison.

abilities.name: Evasive Slither
abilities.details: You move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Divine Conduit
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A person in robes adorned with the divine imagery of their god. Their voice booms with their god’s authority.
tactics: Divine Conduits keep as many allies as possible within their Divine Aura as they attack enemies with Radiant Bolts and Heal or Revivify allies.
lore: Divine Conduits are mortals with a close connection with a god, able to commune with them and channel their divine power directly without prayer. They lead others who worship their god in temples and divine quests.

abilities.name: Divine Aura
abilities.details: You produce a 5 Space Aura of Bright Light. Creatures of your choice within the Aura gain a d8 bonus to Attack Checks and Saves. This effect ends while you’re Dazed.

abilities.name: Inspire
abilities.details: At the start of your turn, you may use the Help Action for free.

abilities.name: MP Effects
abilities.details: For the purpose of Spell Duels, your MP Effects have a +6 bonus to their Check.

abilities.name: Radiant Bolt (MP Effect)
abilities.details:
Ranged Spell Attack vs PD, 10 Spaces, 3 Radiant.

Expose (+1 AP): Agility Save. Failure: Target is Exposed and emits a 1 Space Aura of Bright Light for 1 Round.

abilities.name: Heal (MP Effect)
abilities.details:
You heal a creature within 10 Spaces. Make a DC 15 Spell Check. Failure: The target regains 2 HP. Success: The target regains 3 HP. Success (each 5): +1 HP.

Revivify (+1 AP): You can target a creature who died a maximum of 1 Round ago. They come back to life with 0 HP and Exhaustion before they’re healed.

abilities.name: Spell Duel
abilities.details: When a creature uses an MP Effect with a base AP cost of X, you can attempt to Spell Duel it with a +6 bonus to your Check.

name: Dune Beast
notes: This monster is the volume’s worked leveling example: it begins with the Level 0 Wolf, changes to Large, replaces the Wolf’s Slow enhancement with Mocking Laugh, and adds Removing the Attribute Decrease, HP Increase (+7 HP), Damage Increase (+1 Base Damage), two Damage Resistances (Half), and +1 AD.
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A large beast that is a blend of a wolf and a hyena. It has a thick body with spotted fur, with lean legs that suggest power and speed. Its face is brutish and short, with hard features for a canine. It has a strong musk and a deep, haunting laugh.
tactics: These animals are smarter than they seem, usually attacking in packs of 3–5 to Flank enemies and block off retreats. They love to Taunt their prey (see Mocking Laugh), and then Bite and Restrain them before they rip into them (see Tear Apart).
lore: Dune Beasts are especially savage creatures naturally found in deserts and tundras, where they hunt with their packs. They’re sometimes captured for use in banditry, gladiatorial fights, or war.

abilities.name: Loud
abilities.details: You have DisADV on Stealth Checks.

abilities.name: Keen Senses
abilities.details: You have ADV on Awareness Checks made to hear or smell.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.details: You gain an additional +2 bonus to Attacks against creatures you’re Flanking.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 4 Piercing + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits.

Restrain (+1 AP): Might Save. Failure: Target is Grappled. While Grappled, target is also Restrained.

abilities.name: Tear Apart
abilities.details: A Grappled target: Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 3 Piercing + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Bleeding 2.

abilities.name: Mocking Laugh
abilities.details: When a creature within 10 Spaces fails a Check, you can laugh at them. Contest, Martial Check vs Repeated Charisma Save. Success: Target is Taunted by you for 1 minute. While Taunted, they can’t willingly move away from you.

name: Ettin Knight
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A giant knight in thick plate mail with two helmed heads. It uses both hands to swing a massive sword.
tactics: Ettin Knights charge into battle, using Sundering Strikes against singular foes or Cleaving swings when surrounded. When Attacked in melee, they expertly attempt to disarm their Attackers (see Disarming Parry).
lore: Ettin Knights are elite soldiers among their communities, fiercely loyal to their leaders. They charge into battle with no concern for opposing numbers, using both of their heads to watch their own back.

abilities.name: Two Heads
abilities.details: Enemies don’t gain bonuses for Flanking you.

abilities.name: Sunder Strike
abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Spaces, 3 Slashing and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target takes +1 damage from Physical damage sources for 1 Round.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.details: Area Martial Attack vs AD, 2 Space Arc, 2 Slashing + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits.

abilities.name: Disarming Parry
abilities.details: When you’re Attacked by a Melee Attack vs your PD, you gain a +5 bonus to your PD against the Attack and you attempt to disarm the Attacker. Contest, Martial Check vs Physical Save. Success: After the Attack, the Attacker drops the Weapon used for the Attack to the ground.

name: Giant Webspitter
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A massive brown spider with a bulging abdomen dripping with webbing fluid. It chitters loudly when agitated.
tactics: Giant Webspitters cover their dens in Webs before combat (see Web Ball). They ambush prey from above, using Web Shots to Restrain their prey before Descending and Biting them.
lore: Giant Webspitters hunt from a distance above enemies, only approaching prey when they’re stuck in webbing. They cover their dens in webbing and commonly hunt with other types of spiders that have more potent poisons.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.details: You can walk without falling on the ceiling and vertical surfaces normally without needing to Climb.

abilities.name: Web Walk
abilities.details: You can walk along and through webs unimpeded. Additionally, you know the location of any creature that’s in contact with the same web.

abilities.name: Webs
abilities.details: You create Webs with some of your features. These Webs are objects that have 3 HP, 10 PD, 10 AD, Immunity to Mystical Damage, and Vulnerability (Double) to Slashing, Fire, and Corrosion damage.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 3 Piercing and target makes a Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target takes 1 Poison damage at the start of each of its turns and is Impaired for 1 minute. This is a Basic Poison.

abilities.name: Web Shot
abilities.details: Ranged Martial Attack vs PD, 10 Spaces, 3 Bludgeoning and target makes a Repeated Physical Save. Failure: Target is Restrained in Webs. If this Web is broken, it’s freed.

abilities.name: Web Ball
abilities.details: You cover all surfaces with Webs in a 3 Space diameter Sphere up to 5 Spaces away. This area is Difficult Terrain. When a creature starts their turn on a Space covered by Webs or enters it for the first time on their turn, it makes a Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target is Restrained.

abilities.name: Descend
abilities.details: When you start falling within 2 Spaces of a ceiling with a hard surface that can support your weight, you attach a Web to the ceiling and safely descend up to 10 Spaces. You can hang on the Web there or drop off (no Action required). If the Web takes any damage, it breaks and you fall.

name: Paladin Commander
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A person covered in full gilded plate armor with a tower shield and longsword. Their equipment is magically kept shiny and bright, and they radiate a calming aura of hope.
tactics: Paladin Commanders keep as many allies as possible in their Blessed Aura as they prioritize Commanding Attacks and healing their allies (see Lay on Hands). When up close, they use sword Slashes and Radiant Bursts to defeat their enemies.
lore: Paladin Commanders are seasoned veterans who have risen through the ranks of a paladin order to the top, leading the order in their mission.

abilities.name: Blessed Aura (5 Space Aura)
abilities.details: Creatures of your choice within your Aura have ADV on Saves and regain 1 HP at the start of their turn.

abilities.name: MP Effects
abilities.details: For the purpose of Spell Duels, your MP Effects have a +8 bonus to their Check.

abilities.name: Command Attack
abilities.details: Once per Round, you can command a willing creature that can hear you to make a 1 AP Attack with ADV as a Reaction for free.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands (MP Effect)
abilities.details: You heal a creature within 1 Space of you. Make a DC 15 Spell Check. Failure: The target regains 4 HP. Success: The target regains 5 HP. Success (each 5): +1 HP.

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 5 Slashing.

abilities.name: Radiant Burst (MP Effect)
abilities.details: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 1 Space Aura, 4 Radiant.

name: Psionic Squidling
notes: Hovering Speed: A Flying Speed that allows the creature to stay aloft even after gaining the Prone Condition.
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A large red eye with a horizontal slit connected to a long ovular brain with squid tentacles protruding out of the bottom. It hums slightly as it hovers in the air.
tactics: In Combat, they use Telekinesis to bind a melee combatant, then throw them (see Telekinetic Throw (Creature)) to damage them. They use bolts of psionic energy (see Psi Bolt) to disarm combatants and harm them, prioritizing casters and those Sustaining effects.
lore: Psionic Squidlings originated deep within the Void. They are incredibly intelligent but hard to communicate with as their minds are so alien.
languages: Can communicate telepathically with any creature that knows a Language, but cannot speak

abilities.name: MP Effects
abilities.details: For the purpose of Spell Duels, your MP Effects have a +6 bonus to their Check.

abilities.name: Psi Bolt
abilities.details: Ranged Spell Attack vs PD, 2 Psychic and target makes an Intelligence Save. Failure: Target is Dazed for 1 Round.

abilities.name: Telekinesis (MP Effect)
abilities.details: Contest, 10 Spaces, Spell Check vs Repeated Might Save. Success: Target is Immobilized for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Throw (Creature)
abilities.details: Creature affected by Telekinesis: Contest, Spell Check vs Might Save. Success: Target is thrown up to 4 Spaces.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Throw (Object)
abilities.details: An object within 10 Spaces of you is thrown 3 Spaces. If the object is held by another creature, Contest, Spell Check vs Might Save. Success: You pull the object out of its holder’s grip before the throw. Failure: The throw fails.

abilities.name: Spell Duel
abilities.details: When a creature uses an MP Effect with a base AP cost of X, you can attempt to Spell Duel it with a +6 bonus to your Check.

name: Shadow Guardian
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A large, quiet shadowborn in pitch-black leather armor wielding a short warhammer and a round shield. Their eyes are constantly scanning around them, looking for any possible threat.
tactics: Shadow Guardians stay in their charge’s shadow (see Shadow Espionage) until they’re Attacked, at which time they emerge and protect their charge from harm (see Shadow Protect). They’ll use their Hammer to Knockback enemies, then Shadowbind them. During a fight, they constantly use their body to provide Cover for their charge.
lore: Shadow Guardians are bodyguards that specialize in defending someone without being noticed, or when other guards can’t stay close such as during a party or social event. Nobility sometimes use them in addition to normal guards as a secret final line of defense.

abilities.name: MP Effects
abilities.details: For the purpose of Spell Duels, your MP Effects have a +6 bonus to their Check.

abilities.name: Hammer
abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Bludgeoning + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits.

Knockback (+1 AP): Might Save. Failure: Target is knocked back 1 Space. Failure (each 5): +1 Space.

abilities.name: Shadowbind (MP Effect)
abilities.details: Contest, 10 Spaces, Spell Check vs Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Immobilized for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Shadow Espionage
abilities.details:
You enter or exit a shadow of a creature within 5 Spaces. When you exit, you appear within 1 Space of the shadow. While in the shadow:
• Limited Actions: The only Action you can take is to exit the shadow. When you do, you have ADV on the first Attack you make before the start of your next turn.
• Passenger: You move with the creature’s shadow and remain aware of your surroundings.
• Incorporeal: You become Invisible, gain Physical Resistance (Half), and are immune to being Grappled or Prone.

abilities.name: Shadow Protect
abilities.details: If a creature within 1 Space is Hit by an Attack, the Attack is made against you instead. You take all the damage and the effects instead of them, including making any accompanied Saves. If you’re within the creature’s shadow, you use Shadow Espionage to leave the shadow first.

name: Skeleton Sharpshooter
notes: The printed stat block labels Bow as a Melee Martial Attack despite its 15/45 Space range; the source wording is retained below.
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A reanimated corpse past the point of rotting where only bones remain, armed with a powerful bow and a short sword.
tactics: Skeleton Sharpshooters stay at a range using Bow Attacks and Volleys. They only use their Sword when they can’t easily escape an enemy’s Melee Range.
lore: Skeleton Sharpshooters are the bones of a long-dead marksman, reanimated to serve at the command of a necromancer. They’re frequently stationed in defensive towers or as a troop of archers in an undead army.
languages: You understand the languages you knew in life, but can’t speak

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.details: While you remain motionless, you’re indistinguishable from a dead body.

abilities.name: Sword
abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 3 Slashing.

abilities.name: Bow
abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 15/45 Spaces, 4 Piercing.

Artery Shot (+1 AP): Repeated Physical Save. Failure: Target is Bleeding and Impaired for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.details:
Area Martial Attack vs AD, 15/45 Spaces, 3 Space diameter Sphere, 3 Piercing + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits.

Suppressive Fire (+1 AP): Charisma Save. Failure: Target becomes Hindered for 1 Round.

name: Yeti Frostrager
sourceBook: DC20 Magazine 25: Strong and Simple Monsters
descriptionText: A large apish giant covered in white fur with wide, flat feet. Yeti Frostragers have frozen saliva coating their slack lower jaw, a crown and necklace of yeti teeth, and two massive icicle clubs. Their voice is booming and proud.
tactics: Yeti Frostragers charge toward enemies and Sustain a Taunting Boast to keep them from attacking their allies in group combat, then use icicle clubs (see Icicle Slam) to attack, swinging in Arcs against multiple targets. When struck by a hard blow, they’ll Endure the Attack while making sure to stay on the offensive.
lore: Yeti Berserkers take a tooth from each peer they’ve bested in mortal combat. Their first 10 are fashioned into a necklace. Berserkers with more than 10 kills craft the extra teeth into a crown and are known as Frostragers.

abilities.name: Snow Walker
abilities.details: You’re not affected by Difficult Terrain created by snow.

abilities.name: Dual Wielding
abilities.details: Your second Icicle Slam Attack each round ignores and does not advance the Multiple Check Penalty.

abilities.name: Icicle Slam
abilities.details:
You may move up to half your Speed, then Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 5 Bludgeoning.

Arc (+1 AP): Your Attack becomes a 1 Space Arc.

abilities.name: Taunting Boast
abilities.details: Contest, 5 Space Aura, Influence Check vs Repeated Charisma Save. Success: Target is Taunted by you for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Endure
abilities.details: When you’re Hit by an Attack, you can take 4 less damage from the Attack.
